Membership / Proposed offer

A weekly perspective.
A stronger foundation.

The idea is simple: accessible macro research that helps newer investors understand US and European equity markets. Start with the free historical pilot.

One newsletter. Three things to take away.

Clarity you can build on.

  1. A focused macro briefingThe week’s proposed structure connects a small number of economic developments to broad equity markets, with source links and a clear information cutoff.
  2. Analysis with room for uncertaintyA central interpretation, alternative explanations and questions to watch. Designed to teach reasoning rather than hand out trade instructions.
  3. A learning section every weekOne concept in plain English, an example and a short glossary. A path from recognising a term to understanding why it matters.

Read it before you decide.

The historical pilot demonstrates the intended depth and tone. There is no active paid service or checkout. This prototype tests interest in the concept and its proposed price.

Who it is designed for

Curiosity is the
entry requirement.

You might be a finance student connecting a lecture to the news, a first-time investor trying to understand an index, or a curious reader building a weekly market habit.

This is general educational research. It does not assess your circumstances, suitability or portfolio, and does not provide personal investment advice.
